title: Combine conditions with and, or and not
objective: Join two checks with and or or, and flip a check with not.

body.text: Sometimes one check is not enough. You can join checks with three words. The word and needs both conditions to be true. The word or needs at least one of them to be true. The word not turns a true condition into a false one, and a false one into a true one. Put a comparison in brackets after not, so it is clear which part it applies to: not (age is less than 13).

body.title: Join conditions
body.code:
make score equal to 90
if score is at least 80 and score is at most 100
    say "Passing"

make weekend equal to true
make holiday equal to false
if weekend or holiday
    say "No school"
if not holiday
    say "A normal day"

body.prompt: The program calls a 30-year-old a teen, but only ages 13 to 19 should count. Make it print not a teen.
body.starter:
make age equal to 30
if age is at least 13 or age is at most 19
    say "teen"
otherwise
    say "not a teen"
body.solution:
make age equal to 30
if age is at least 13 and age is at most 19

otherwise
    say "not a teen"
